limitations: Candidate requested verbs are weak proposals; primary labels use RGB review.
One apartment per split; source families and target classes are partly confounded.
FP32 native versus FP32 image pooling still differs in token structure; 4-bit is an additional system baseline.
Reversed and static clips are interventions, not newly labeled physical actions.

protocol.labels: Source RGB review required before primary scoring; weak requested actions are not truth.

queries.none: A person approaching or looking at an object without manipulating it.
queries.pickup: A person picking up an object.
queries.putdown: A person putting an object down.
queries.stand: A person standing up from a seat.
queries.switch_off: A person switching an appliance off.
queries.switch_on: A person switching an appliance on.

protocol.window_policy: Sit center = exported end minus 750 ms; other actions use exported midpoint; controls use trajectory end minus 1 s. Source-review correction before model inference.
